title: DNS TXT Key Publication
nlang_code:
mod blocks AphTxtKeyRecord {
  props {
    version: str,   // tag `v`   — literal "APHv1"
    alg: str,       // tag `alg` — "ed25519" or "p256"
    k: str,         // tag `k`   — base64url public key, unpadded
    #[optional(true)]
    kid: str,
    #[optional(true)]
    did: str,
    #[optional(true)]
    not_before: str,
    #[optional(true)]
    not_after: str,
  }
}
note: A DKIM-style tag-list published at `_aph._notary.<domain>`, anchoring notary identity to domain ownership exactly as DKIM anchors email signing keys. Required tags are v, alg and k. `kid` is matched against the fragment of proof.verificationMethod, which is what makes rotation unambiguous while an old and a new key are published side by side; notBefore/notAfter bound the window.
book_ref: APH Spec: §8.4.5 DNS TXT — DKIM-style publication
